title: Dual J-K flip-flop with preset and clear

sources.document: TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 5 (pin assignments and function tables)
TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 6 (gate and flip-flop data sheets)

functions.text: Inverse of 1Q (both high while 1PR and 1CLR are both low).
Inverse of 2Q (both high while 2PR and 2CLR are both low).

state.changesOn: falling edge of nCK (master-slave), each flip-flop on its own clock
rules: PR low, CLR high: Q = 1, Q' = 0 at once
PR high, CLR low: Q = 0, Q' = 1 at once
PR low, CLR low: Q = 1 and Q' = 1; not stable, does not persist when PR and CLR return high
Master-slave, pulse triggered: J and K are taken in while CK is high (setup 0 ns before the rising edge, hold 0 ns after the falling edge); the outputs change on the falling edge of CK
On a CK pulse with clear/preset inactive: J=0 K=0 hold; J=1 K=0 Q=1; J=0 K=1 Q=0; J=1 K=1 toggle

notes: This is the plain '76 (master-slave, pulse triggered). The 74LS76 is negative-edge triggered. The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
